aboutSubheading: Over 15 years of precision joinery and custom cabinet making
aboutText: Ryan's Cabinets has been delivering high-quality custom cabinetry to homes and businesses across Melbourne for over 15 years. From sleek modern kitchens to classic timber vanities, every piece is designed and built with care right here in our Melbourne workshop. We pride ourselves on honest advice, transparent pricing and craftsmanship that speaks for itself.

servicesSubheading: Complete cabinet making and joinery solutions for every room in your home
servicesText: Whether you're renovating your kitchen, upgrading the laundry or building a new home, Ryan's Cabinets has the expertise to deliver stunning results. We handle everything from initial design through to final installation.

services.title: Custom Kitchens
services.desc: Beautiful, functional kitchen cabinetry designed and built to suit your lifestyle and space. From contemporary handleless designs to classic shaker styles.

services.title: Vanities & Bathrooms
services.desc: Custom bathroom vanities and cabinetry crafted with moisture-resistant materials to stand up to Melbourne's changing climate.

services.title: Built-In Robes
services.desc: Maximise your bedroom storage with bespoke built-in wardrobes tailored to your space, complete with shelving, drawers and hanging solutions.

services.title: Laundry Fitouts
services.desc: Smart laundry cabinetry and benchtops that make the most of every centimetre. Overhead cupboards, pull-out hampers and folding stations.

services.title: Insurance Repairs
services.desc: We work directly with insurance companies to repair or replace cabinetry damaged by water, fire or other insured events across Melbourne.

services.title: Design & Drawings
services.desc: Professional 3D designs and detailed drawings so you can visualise your new cabinetry before a single cut is made. No surprises, just stunning results.

testimonialsSubheading: Real feedback from real Melbourne homeowners

testimonials.text: Ryan and his team did an absolutely ripper job on our kitchen renovation in Brunswick. The cabinetry is flawless, the soft-close drawers are spot on, and he even helped us tweak the design to get more bench space. Couldn't be happier — highly recommend!
testimonials.name: Dave Mitchell

testimonials.text: We had Ryan build custom robes for all three bedrooms and a new vanity for the ensuite. The quality is outstanding and the price was very fair. He was always on time, kept the place tidy and the finished product looks a million bucks. Best cabinet maker in Melbourne.
testimonials.name: Sarah Lawson

testimonials.text: After a burst pipe ruined our laundry cabinetry, Ryan's Cabinets handled the insurance repair from start to finish. They liaised with the insurer, kept us informed the whole way and the new laundry looks better than the original. Top blokes, great workmanship.
testimonials.name: Tom Papadopoulos
